audio.t: Attention, visitors to Lakeside Memorial Hospital.
Beginning this Monday, the main parking garage will be closed for two weeks while crews repair the ramps.
During this time, please park in Lot C on Harbor Street.
A free shuttle bus will carry you to the main entrance every ten minutes.
If you or a family member has difficulty walking, a wheelchair is available at the main entrance upon request.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: Who is the announcement intended for?
questions.explain: Mở đầu 'Attention, visitors to Lakeside Memorial Hospital' → dành cho khách đến bệnh viện.

questions.q: What will happen on Monday?
options: A parking garage will close for repairs.
questions.explain: 'Beginning this Monday, the main parking garage will be closed for two weeks'. Xe đưa đón thì bắt đầu chạy chứ không kết thúc.

questions.q: What can visitors with difficulty walking get?
questions.explain: 'A wheelchair is available at the main entrance upon request'.

audio.t: Hi Carla, it's Greg calling from the main office.
I'm calling about tomorrow's visit from the auditors.
Their flight got in early, so they'll arrive at the plant at eight thirty instead of ten o'clock.
That means we'll have to move up the tour of the packaging line.
Could you make sure the quality control records for the last three months are on my desk before they get here?
Also, please remind your team to wear their safety glasses at all times.
Call me back if there are any problems. Thanks.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To discuss a visit by auditors
questions.explain: Ông nói 'I'm calling about tomorrow's visit from the auditors'.

questions.q: What has changed about the visit?
questions.explain: Họ sẽ đến lúc 8:30 thay vì 10:00. Chuyến tham quan chỉ bị dời sớm lên, độ dài không đổi.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
questions.explain: 'Make sure the quality control records for the last three months are on my desk'.

audio.t: Looking for the freshest ingredients at the best prices?
Then visit Greenfield Market this weekend for the grand opening of our new in-store bakery.
Our bakers start work at four every morning, so every loaf, roll, and pastry is warm when you pick it up.
Spend thirty dollars or more on Saturday or Sunday, and take home a free loaf of our famous sourdough bread.
Rewards members will also earn double points on all bakery items. Just show your card at the register.
Greenfield Market is located at the corner of Pine and Third, and we're open every day until eleven p.m.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.explain: 'The grand opening of our new in-store bakery'.

questions.q: What can customers get if they spend thirty dollars?
questions.explain: 'Spend thirty dollars or more… take home a free loaf of our famous sourdough bread'.

questions.q: What should rewards members do to earn double points?
options: Show their cards at the register
questions.explain: 'Rewards members will also earn double points… Just show your card at the register'.

audio.t: Thank you for calling Summit Community Bank.
Please note that all of our branches will be closed this Monday in observance of the national holiday.
We will reopen on Tuesday at nine a.m.
During the closure, our ATMs and online banking services will be available as usual.
However, loan consultations and currency exchange will resume on Tuesday.
If you need to report a lost or stolen card, please press one now, and a representative will help you right away.
For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.

questions.q: What will happen on Monday?
questions.explain: 'All of our branches will be closed this Monday in observance of the national holiday'.

questions.q: Which service will remain available during the closure?
questions.explain: 'Our ATMs and online banking services will be available as usual'. Vay vốn và đổi tiền chỉ trở lại từ thứ Ba.

questions.q: What should callers do to report a stolen card?
questions.explain: 'If you need to report a lost or stolen card, please press one'. 'Stay on the line' là cho các thắc mắc khác.

audio.t: May I have your attention, please?
The five forty-five express to Marlow has been delayed by about thirty minutes due to a signal problem.
It is now expected to depart at six fifteen.
Please note that this train will leave from platform four instead of platform two.
As an apology, passengers on this train may collect a free snack voucher at the information desk.
We will make another announcement at six o'clock. Thank you for traveling with us.

questions.q: What is the announcement about?
questions.explain: 'The five forty-five express to Marlow has been delayed by about thirty minutes'.

questions.q: What are passengers told about the platform?
options: It is on the upper level.
questions.explain: 'This train will leave from platform four instead of platform two' → đã đổi sân ga.

questions.q: What can passengers get at the information desk?
questions.explain: 'May collect a free snack voucher at the information desk'.

audio.t: Good morning, and welcome to the Riverside Public Library's recorded information line.
I'd like to share two pieces of news.
First, beginning next month, we'll install self-checkout machines near the main entrance, so you'll be able to borrow books without waiting in line.
Second, our Winter Reading Challenge is back.
Anyone who reads five books before the end of March will be entered into a prize drawing for a tablet computer.
To take part, simply register at the information desk by January fifteenth.
Staff will be happy to recommend books for every age group.

questions.q: What change will take place next month?
options: The library will close on Sundays.
questions.explain: 'Beginning next month, we'll install self-checkout machines near the main entrance'.

questions.q: What will participants receive for finishing the reading challenge?
options: A chance to win a prize
questions.explain: Đọc 5 cuốn sách sẽ 'be entered into a prize drawing' (được tham gia bốc thăm trúng thưởng).

questions.q: What must listeners do by January fifteenth?
questions.explain: 'Simply register at the information desk by January fifteenth' → đăng ký tham gia chương trình.

audio.t: Good morning, everyone, and thanks for coming in early.
I have a quick update on the Brightside Dental account.
The client loved our first presentation, but they've asked us to rethink the audience.
They'd like the campaign to appeal to young adults instead of families, which means we'll move most of our ads from newspapers to social media.
Because of that, the deadline has been extended to March third.
Mark will still lead the design team, but I need every one of you to send me at least two fresh ideas by Wednesday.
Let's make this one count.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker addressing?
questions.explain: Cô nói về 'our first presentation', 'design team', 'send me ideas' → đồng nghiệp trong công ty quảng cáo.

questions.q: What has the client asked the agency to change?
questions.explain: 'They've asked us to rethink the audience… appeal to young adults instead of families'.

questions.q: What are the listeners asked to do by Wednesday?
questions.explain: 'Send me at least two fresh ideas by Wednesday'.

audio.t: In local business news this morning, Hartley Furniture, the town's largest employer, has announced plans to build a second factory on the east side of the city.
Construction is expected to begin next spring and finish within eighteen months.
The company says the new factory will create about two hundred jobs.
A spokesperson said Hartley intends to hire mostly from the local area, and no previous manufacturing experience is required.
Interested residents can attend a job fair at the community center on October twelfth.
And now, a look at the weather.

questions.q: What is the report mainly about?
options: A company's plan to open a new factory
questions.explain: 'Hartley Furniture… has announced plans to build a second factory'.

questions.q: What will take place on October twelfth?
options: A factory tour will be held.
A job fair will be held.
A new product will be launched.
questions.explain: 'Interested residents can attend a job fair at the community center on October twelfth'. Xây dựng bắt đầu vào mùa xuân.

questions.q: What does the company say about hiring?
options: It will mostly hire local residents.
It will recruit workers from overseas.
questions.explain: 'Hartley intends to hire mostly from the local area, and no previous manufacturing experience is required'.

audio.t: Welcome to Brightwater Bottling, everyone. My name is Helen, and I'll be your guide today.
The tour will take about forty-five minutes, and we'll walk through the entire production process.
We'll begin at the receiving dock, where the water is tested, and then move on to the bottling line.
For your safety, please stay behind the yellow lines at all times.
I also have to ask that you not take photographs near the filling machines, since the equipment is protected by patents.
At the end of the tour, you can pick up some free samples in our gift shop.
If you have any questions along the way, please don't hesitate to ask.

questions.q: Who is the speaker addressing?
questions.explain: Cô là hướng dẫn viên: 'I'll be your guide today… the tour will take about forty-five minutes'.

questions.q: What are listeners asked not to do?
questions.explain: 'I have to ask that you not take photographs near the filling machines'.

questions.q: What can listeners get at the end of the tour?
questions.explain: 'You can pick up some free samples in our gift shop'.

audio.t: Good morning, and welcome to Oakdale Clinic. I'm Dr. Singh, the head of nursing.
I know you're all eager to get started, so I'll keep this brief.
First, you'll each receive an ID badge from the security office down the hall.
After that, we'll tour the clinic and go over how to use our electronic patient records.
For your first two weeks, you'll be shadowing experienced nurses rather than working on your own.
Your schedules are posted on the board outside this room.
If anything is unclear, please ask me or any member of the staff.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the talk?
questions.explain: 'Welcome to Oakdale Clinic… you'll each receive an ID badge… your first two weeks' → buổi định hướng cho nhân viên mới.

questions.q: What will the listeners do first?
questions.explain: 'First, you'll each receive an ID badge'. Tham quan phòng khám đến sau ('After that').

questions.q: What will the listeners do for the first two weeks?
questions.explain: 'For your first two weeks, you'll be shadowing experienced nurses'.
